design_probes.design_claim: The official v014 config materializes only nominal and left-knee attenuation rows without changing the deployable Actor input.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Compose the official profile, apply the existing reset-time actuator-strength owner in real MuJoCo, and expose the applied multiplier only through physics and typed privileged Kp/Kd scales.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 real MuJoCo rows and one reset under a fixed seed.
design_probes.falsifier: Any non-index-3 actuator varies, multiplier escapes [0.8,1.0], nominal or attenuated stratum is absent, or Actor/Critic identity changes from 98/303.
design_probes.success_witness: Both nominal and attenuated index-3 rows were observed; every other actuator scale was one; Actor/Critic remained 98/303.

design_probes.design_claim: The official v014 route carries real stand/walk MuJoCo Reward through production replay into finite privileged SAC updates.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Activate both command modes, preserve Reward identity in ReplayBuffer, consume both modes, and update the production Critic and Actor once.
design_probes.minimal_case: 32 real MuJoCo rows, one zero-action control transition, 128 replay samples, one Critic update, and one Actor update.
design_probes.falsifier: Wrong 98/303/29 identity, absent stand or walk rows, missing telemetry, non-finite Reward, replay mismatch, non-finite update, or unchanged Actor.
design_probes.success_witness: 11 stand rows, 21 walk rows, 128 reward-identical samples, six finite Critic metrics, four finite Actor metrics, and an Actor parameter delta.

design_probes.design_claim: The v014 effective config identity is sealed into strict full-state checkpoints and one exact 20+1 Oracle lineage.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Round-trip full learner state after deliberate mutation and finalize iterations 240 through 4800 plus 5000 through the production gateway.
design_probes.minimal_case: One full model_240 state save/reload and 21 tiny-payload lifecycle saves through the bound gateway.
simplifications: tiny state payload for remaining lineage files
design_probes.falsifier: Post-validation mutation, failed restoration, config identity mismatch, missing/extra/mixed checkpoint, or wrong final iteration.
design_probes.success_witness: A deliberately mutated Actor restored exactly and one manifest recorded 21 checkpoint hashes with final_iteration 5000.

design_probes.design_claim: The production server collector subprocess and CUDA learner carry the admitted v014 identities through the first live update.
design_probes.necessary_capability: Complete one MuJoCo collector to CPU-pinned double-buffer to CUDA learner transaction with both command modes and gain strata represented.

design_probes.falsifier: Any collector, Gain stratum, command mode, tensor, transfer, CUDA, child-lifecycle, numeric, or write-boundary failure.
design_probes.success_witness: One finite CUDA learner update whose collected batch contains both command modes and v014 gain strata.

live_only_unknowns.why_offline_impossible: The local machine has no server CUDA device and the local formal test directly fills ReplayBuffer rather than starting the production collector subprocess; it cannot prove CUDA compilation, pinned transfer, child lifecycle, or the first live update.
live_only_unknowns.falsifier: Collector startup failure, missing command mode or gain stratum, wrong 98/303/29 tensors, pinned-transfer failure, non-finite metrics, child death, or write outside the fresh audit directory.
live_only_unknowns.cost: One server GPU, 32 MuJoCo environments, a fresh isolated directory, and at most 120 seconds; stop after the first finite update or first invariant failure.
live_only_unknowns.stop_condition: Stop immediately after the first finite collector-to-CUDA-learner update, at 120 seconds, or on the first identity, lifecycle, distribution, or numeric failure; never continue the Oracle campaign.

claims.scope: The official local v014 config materializes the gain-targeted MuJoCo reset and carries real dual Reward through production replay into one finite privileged SAC Critic and Actor update.
The v014 resolved config identity strictly round-trips full state and the production gateway finalizes one exact 20+1 lineage.

negative_scope: No server CUDA collector transaction, long training, convergence, locomotion quality, IDM/Planner readiness, commit, push, or deployment is claimed.
